translationRepairs: After Jingzhou fell the court moved to Wuchang, where Shi Yi became a rear-guard general, then village marquis at the metropolitan gate, while remaining palace attendant.
After Jingzhou fell the court moved to Wuchang, where Shi Yi became a subordinate general (pi jiangjun), then village marquis of the capital precinct, while remaining palace attendant.

拜裨將軍 names the subordinate/assistant generalship 裨將軍, not 後將軍 “rear-guard general”; 都亭侯 is the capital-precinct village marquis. The proposed idiomatic line corrects both mistranslations without adding unsupported content.

Yet Guang left a year ago and not a word has returned—did my message ever reach you? I gaze south and sigh as the months pass; even Lu Wang and Gao Zi scarcely match my longing! And now I am treated coldly; slander never stops—I am sure to suffer for it, only sooner or later.

Yet Guang left a year ago and not a word has returned—did my message ever reach you? I gaze south and sigh as the months pass; even Lu’s longing for Gaozi scarcely matches this! And now I am treated coldly; slander never stops—I am sure to suffer for it, only sooner or later.
魯望高子 is the classical allusion of Lu longing for Gaozi, not two persons Lu Wang and Gao Zi; the proposed wording restores that sense and removes the invented name Lu Wang.
Chen Shou concludes that Shi Yi, Xu Xiang, and Hu Zong were the men who kept Sun Quan's government running.
The appraisal states that Shi Yi, Xu Xiang, and Hu Zong were the men who kept Sun Quan's government running.
評曰 introduces the historian’s appraisal without naming Chen Shou; “Chen Shou concludes” invents an attribution absent from the Chinese, and “The appraisal states” matches 評曰.
Moreover, on a day when your subject Zhi is clearly guilty, he ought of himself to rush to the cauldron and cauldron, binding his body to await punishment—this is what a minister should do.
Moreover, on a day when your subject Zhi is clearly guilty, he ought of himself to rush to the tripod and the cauldron, binding his body to await punishment—this is what a minister should do.

鼎鑊 is the paired execution vessels ding and huo; “cauldron and cauldron” wrongly duplicates one gloss, but “cauldron and wok” is awkward for this punishment context—render the pair as tripod and cauldron.
